explanation: I searched Mathlib for wedge, domCoprod and alternatization declarations, including Topology/Algebra/Module/Alternating and LinearAlgebra/Alternating/DomCoprod. Mathlib has `ContinuousMultilinearMap.alternatization_apply_apply`, but the proof of `pairedWedge_apply` already uses it, and it is only one ingredient. I found no Mathlib definition of a continuous paired wedge product of alternating maps along a bilinear pairing `μ`. This theorem unfolds the library's own `pairedWedge` definition, so no Mathlib declaration states the same formula.
